title: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of the NeuEve Dryness Treatment Kit on Vaginal Health, Comfort, and Quality of Life in Postmenopausal Women
official: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of the NeuEve Dryness Treatment Kit on Vaginal Health, Comfort, and Quality of Life in Postmenopausal Women
summary: This is a decentralized, single-group, open-label clinical trial evaluating a 12-week regimen of the NeuEve Dryness Treatment Kit (comprising Feminine Moisture Support oral softgels, Bone Support oral capsules, NeuEve Salve vulvar topical cream, NeuEve vaginal suppositories, and NeuEve Multivitamin) in postmenopausal women aged 55-65 who experience vaginal dryness, painful sex, and vaginal itching. The study aims to evaluate the effect of the kit on vaginal symptoms, vaginal pH, vaginal microbiome composition, sexual function, and quality of life over 12 weeks of use.
conditions: Improves Strength & Elasticity of Vagina (Aka Collagen and Elastin)
Improves Vaginal Microbiome i.e. Increases Lactobacilli
Reduces Vaginal Itching, Improves Vaginal Burning & Discharge
criteria:
Exclusion Criteria:

Female, aged 55-65 years at the time of consent. Postmenopausal (defined as ≥12 consecutive months without menstrual bleeding, or surgical menopause). Currently experiencing self-reported vaginal dryness, painful sex (dyspareunia), and vaginal itching. Willing and able to use all five products of the NeuEve Dryness Treatment Kit as directed for 12 weeks. Willing to perform at-home vaginal pH testing and at-home vaginal microbiome sample collection. Willing to maintain current diet, sleep schedule, and physical activity level for the duration of the 12-week study. Willing to complete all study questionnaires via the Citruslabs platform. Resides in the United States with a deliverable shipping address.

Exclusion criteria:

Known allergy or hypersensitivity to any ingredient in any component of the NeuEve Dryness Treatment Kit (including palm/coconut oil, beeswax, sea buckthorn, evening primrose, botanical extracts, or essential oils listed in the formulations). Currently pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy during the study period. Self-reported diagnosed with or treated for a sexually transmitted infection (STI), pelvic inflammatory disease (PID), or a vaginal or urinary tract infection within the past 30 days. Current use of systemic or vaginal estrogen therapy, vaginal DHEA, or any other prescription treatment for vaginal dryness/GSM, unless on a stable regimen for ≥3 months and willing to maintain it without changes during the study (use of competing topical/vaginal moisturizers, lubricants, or suppositories during the study period is not permitted). History of gynecologic cancer (cervical, vaginal, vulvar, endometrial, or ovarian) within the past 2 years, or current active malignancy. Current participation in another interventional clinical study. Any medical condition that, in the opinion of the investigator, would compromise participant safety or the integrity of the study data. Planning to travel outside of the United States during the study duration.
